description: Search the official U.S. Census Bureau Schedule B (10-digit export classification used to file Electronic Export Information) by product words or by code prefix. Returns up to 50 codes with their official description and a link to each code's page (unit of quantity, when EEI is required, HS code used abroad, top U.S. export markets).

query.description: Product words (e.g. "frozen shrimp") or a Schedule B code prefix (e.g. "8703.23").

name: find_schedule_b
title: Find a U.S. Schedule B export code
